notes.title: Techsmith+ Released
notes.content:
[h1]What is Techsmith+ ?[/h1]
Once you have purchased all upgrades in the Techsmith, you will unlock Techsmith+. This reveals a new collection of upgrades to purchase for your gyrocopter.

[h1]If you experience any issues[/h1]
If anything breaks, please let us know by using the "Bug Report" functionality on the game's main menu. Please make sure to attach error logs (if any), and your e-mail address for follow-ups (that's all we use it for).

[h1]Full changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] Implemented Techsmith+.
[*] Significant performance improvements, designed to cope better with overpowered runs. 
[*] Made Treasure Golem behaviour less annoying.
[*] Added an option that allows disabling intense biome specific particle effects, which can cause performance issues on some systems.
[*] Reduced intensity and frequency of in-game cross promo.
[/list]

notes.title: Techsmith+ - beta available now!
notes.content:
[h1]What is Techsmith+ ?[/h1]
Once you have purchased all upgrades in the Techsmith, you will unlock Techsmith+. This reveals a new collection of upgrades to purchase for your gyrocopter.

The feature has been fully implemented, and we are looking for players to test it to ensure everything is working as expected before rolling it out on the main branch.

[h1]How can I get access to it right now?[/h1]
The update containing Techsmith+ is live on the experimental branch. See instructions on how to access it below. Please note that using the experimental branch means your save file is at risk.

[h3]Switching to the experimental branch[/h3]
Go to your library
Right click the game and select Properties...
Select Betas
Select experimental in the Beta Participation dropdown
Close the window
Wait for the update
Launch the game 

If you have any issues or feedback, please let us know!

[h1]Full changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] Implemented Techsmith+.
[*] Made Treasure Golem behaviour less annoying.
[*] Added an option that allows disabling intense biome specific particle effects, which can cause performance issues on some systems.
[*] Reduced intensity and frequency of in-game cross promo.
[/list]

notes.title: Techsmith+
notes.content:
We are considering a new feature and would love to hear your thoughts.

In order to extend the game's progression past the main story and once all upgrades have been purchased, we would like to add something called "Techsmith+".

This would automatically unlock once all upgrades in the regular Techsmith have been purchased. A new set of upgrades would be presented. Current list is:

[h1]Core ideas:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Even more damage
[*] Upgrade that grants chance to spawn hull repair blocks
[*] Upgrade that grants chance to spawn temporary invincibility blocks
[*] Upgrade that grants chance to spawn temporary movement boost blocks
[*] Upgrade that grants chance to spawn enemy splash damage blocks (damages all enemies in large radius)
[/list]


[h1]Potential upgrades (with question marks):[/h1]
[list]
[*] Even more fire rate (fire rate is a key driver of performance issues though..! Perhaps just a few expensive ticks?)
[*] Even more fuel (again, longer runs = higher chance of poor performance. Could make the fuel increase marginal compared to the standard fuel tank?)
[/list]

Any feedback is welcome, but would love to hear your thoughts on these proposed upgrades and if there are any other types of upgrades you would like to see.

Thanks!

notes.title: Anti-virus update
notes.content:
We have recently had some issues with the game executable being marked as unsafe by various anti-virus programs. We have done extensive work to rectify this, including reaching out to individual anti-virus vendors to have the game marked as safe.

If you have any issues, please follow the instructions below:

[h1]Windows Defender[/h1]
The executable has been confirmed as safe by Microsoft. Please update Windows Defender and try again.

If you have updated and you are still receiving alerts, please follow the instructions below.

The steps below clear cached detections and obtain the latest malware definitions.

[code]Open command prompt as an administrator

cd "C:\Program Files\Windows Defender"

MpCmdRun.exe -removedefinitions -dynamicsignatures

MpCmdRun.exe -SignatureUpdate[/code]

[h1]Bitdefender[/h1]
The executable has been confirmed as safe by Bitdefender. Please update Bitdefender and try again.

[h1]GData Total Security[/h1]
The executable has been confirmed as safe by GData. Please update Total Security and try again.

[h1]Still have issues?[/h1]
If you still have any issues with anti-virus at this point, please share:
* Your Windows version
* What AV software is flagging the file
* What the threat name is
If your anti-virus software has a way to report a false positive, please do so.

notes.title: Bore Blasters review: achieve catharsis as a dwarf yelling and shooting mud
notes.content:
I tried to look up the plot of Bore Blasters, because my focus when playing the game is entirely on exploding dirt, but it turns out the Steam store page doesn't bother to explain any kind of plot either. Thus, the purity of Bore Blasters. Some facts can be divined from the earth, though: you play a dwarf, piloting a small ship akin to Robotnik's flying hedghog killer, and are dropped off on a small, discrete, gem-bearing chunk of dirt. This you pulverise, in a downward direction, with the aim of finding a huge chest of gems at the bottom somewhere. Your drill is the machine gun on your ship, your efforts governed by about two minutes worth of depleting fuel and a hull that can take three hits total. It's cyberpunk by Gimli.

Read more

notes.title: Daily Runs
notes.content:
This update introduces daily runs! Compete in order to get the best score in a variety of scenarios:

Elimination - Defeat as many enemies as possible
Extraction - Get to the chest as quickly as possible
Destruction - Destroy as many blocks as possible
Acquisition - Get the highest score possible
Collection - Gather as many artefacts as possible

Note that only the first run of the day is added to the leaderboard, so make it count!

Also note that you need to unlock the Vault in Campaign Mode to unlock daily runs.

Other changes in this update:
Exploding blocks now scale with player damage
Picking up fuel blocks after running out now works properly
Attempted fix for game freezing at the start of a run

notes.title: Endgame Roadmap
notes.content:
This is a quick note to update you all on what we are working on after processing all the feedback we have received. Our first priority is of course bug fixes, however we have also come up with a roadmap to flesh out the endgame for the levels after the main quest (in its current state) is completed.

Here is what we have planned currently:
(Very light spoilers hidden behind spoiler tags)
* A questline [spoiler]exploring the fate of King Grimnir Hoardbeard[/spoiler]
* A questline [spoiler]delving into the depths of the ancient dwarven ruins[/spoiler]
* Daily runs, with a variety of scoring objectives
* A post-100% challenge mode, with randomly generated levels of increasing toughness

We'll be rolling out updates gradually as the content is developed.

notes.title: Raucous new indie game feels like endgame Terraria, out now on Steam
notes.content:
At the very end of Terraria, after you've done just about everything else there is to do and beaten every boss, you get the Drill Containment Unit. This flying mining tool allows you to blast through the world in mere seconds, obliterating everything in your wake; it's the ultimate reward for a lifetime of hard work. But as anyone who's played Deep Rock Galactic can tell you, the modern videogame dwarf spares no expense when it comes to digging, and so it is in new indie game Bore Blasters, a delightful cacophony of crust-carving, out now on Steam.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: You're going to need to take mining-shooter BORE BLASTERS away from me
notes.content:
BORE BLASTERS is a mining-shooter from Scottish studio 8BitSkull, the same developer that also made Void Scrappers and Fates of Ort, two other games I also quite liked. It seems they're onto something again here!

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/02/youre-going-to-need-to-take-mining-shooter-bore-blasters-away-from-me

notes.title: Bore Blasters and its mix of Vampire Survivors meets Dome Keeper is, dare I say it, a blast
notes.content:
Many a Survivors-like has come and gone over the last couple of years, but Bore Blasters might be the first one that's really struck a chord with me. Or maybe that should be struck gold, as this mining roguelike is all about collecting little gem-like nuggets while boring deep underground for treasure and fending off all manner of flying eyeballs, bats and other unmentionable horrors with wings. I've been playing its Steam Next Fest demo this morning, and my initial impression is that it's a little bit Dome Keeper, a little bit SteamWorld Dig, and very, very good. Even better, developers 8BitSkull have just announced it's coming out in full next month.

Read more
